items.title: 哈佛大学研究人员：AI 编程目前的瓶颈是“Code Review”
items.raw_text: 哈佛大学两位博士候选人做了一份工作论文，把 AI 编程 Agent 的真实效果算了一遍。样本是 718 家公司、725938 名员工。 结论不太好看。 用上 AI 编程 Agent 之后，人均每月新增代码行数从 5017 涨到 6511，多了约 30%。提交数增长 20%，Pull Request 增长 23%。该有的增长都出现了。 但活干完了吗？没有。 论文用 Jira i...
items.reason_zh: 基于大样本实证揭示AI编程瓶颈在代码审查，对工程实践有直接指导意义。
items.summary_zh: 哈佛大学两位博士候选人的工作论文基于718家公司、725938名员工的样本，评估AI编程Agent的实际效果。研究发现，使用AI编程Agent后，人均每月新增代码行数从5017行增至6511行，增长约30%；提交数增长20%，Pull Request增长23%。然而，通过Jira数据分析发现，任务完成情况并未同步提升，表明当前AI编程的瓶颈在于代码审查（Code Review）环节。
items.title_zh: 哈佛大学研究人员：AI编程目前的瓶颈是“Code Review”

items.title: The War Against Slop and an Emerging Weapon to Fight it: Formal Verification
items.raw_text: Proving software correct with math has traditionally required specialist work. Now AI and Lean are helping automate the process.
items.reason_zh: 探讨用形式化验证对抗AI垃圾内容，结合Lean与AI自动化证明，有启发性。
items.summary_zh: 文章探讨了形式化验证作为对抗低质量 AI 生成内容（slop）的新兴武器。传统上，用数学证明软件正确性需要专家工作，但现在 AI 和 Lean 定理证明器正在帮助自动化这一过程。作者认为，形式化验证能提供数学上的正确性保证，从而区分高质量内容与 AI 生成的垃圾。文章可能涉及 Lean 语言、AI 辅助证明的进展以及面临的挑战。
items.title_zh: 对抗垃圾内容的战争与新兴武器：形式化验证

items.title: Keel: A Frontier Model Teaches a Vision-Language Model by Rewriting Its Weights
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2611.25257v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Can a frontier model repair a vision-language model (VLM) by rewriting its weights? Small reasoning VLMs such as Qwen3.5 need such a repair: in thinking mode they fall into loops on many image questions, repeating themselves until the token limit, spending the whole budget and losing the answer. The usual remedies act on the decoding, leaving the looping model as it was, or must be told what to change. Yet the cause is written in the weights. Keel, the first agentic weight-editing method for VLMs on image tasks, finds and removes it there. Told only the symptom, an editor, a frontier multimodal LLM acting as an agent, locates the cause, edits the weights and tests them, with a failure census and instruments showing it the failing images and where the VLM attends; among several editors, the harness keeps only edits that clearly reduce the failure without lowering accuracy on questions no editor saw. items.reason_zh: 提出用前沿模型直接改写小 VLM 权重来修复思考模式死循环，思路新颖，对模型修复与权重编辑有启发。
items.summary_zh: 论文提出一个大胆问题：前沿模型能否通过改写权重来修复一个视觉语言模型。作者以 Qwen3.5 这类小型推理 VLM 为对象，指出其在思考模式下遇到许多图像问题会陷入循环，反复重复直到耗尽 token 预算而丢失答案。常规补救手段作用在解码层面，无法触及模型内部。Keel 方法让前沿模型直接改写目标 VLM 的权重，从参数层面修复该缺陷，为模型修复与权重编辑提供了新路径。
items.title_zh: Keel：前沿模型通过改写权重来教视觉语言模型

items.title: Channel-wise Vector Quantization: Native 1D Visual Tokenization with Learnable Ordering
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2605.26089v3 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: We present Channel-wise Vector Quantization (CVQ), a novel image tokenization paradigm that replaces patch-wise tokens with channel-wise tokens. Unlike conventional vector quantization, which assigns a discrete token to each patch feature vector, CVQ quantizes each channel of the feature map. This represents an image as a 1D channel sequence with learnable coarse-to-fine ordering, rather than a 2D patch grid. Based on CVQ, we introduce a new visual autoregressive framework with "next-channel prediction". Instead of rendering images patch by patch in raster order, our Channel-wise Autoregressive (CAR) model predicts image channels sequentially, producing progressively enriched visual details. Specifically, it first sketches global structure and then refines fine-grained attributes, akin to a human artist's workflow. Empirically, we show that: (1) CVQ exhibits strong codebook scalability, maintaining 95%+ utilization with up to $2^{16}
items.reason_zh: 提出通道级向量量化，用一维通道序列替代patch级token并引入可学习排序，是视觉tokenizer的新架构思路。
items.summary_zh: 论文提出通道级向量量化（CVQ），一种新的图像token化范式。与传统方法为每个patch特征向量分配离散token不同，CVQ对特征图的每个通道进行量化，将图像表示为一维通道序列，并引入可学习排序机制。这种设计改变了视觉token的粒度与组织方式，为视觉tokenizer提供了不同于patch-wise方案的新路径。论文给出方法框架与实验验证，可能对多模态模型的视觉编码效率与表示质量产生影响。
items.title_zh: 通道级向量量化：带可学习排序的原生一维视觉token化

items.title: Phantom Success, Silent Failure: Auditing the Success Checkers of Simulated Manipulation Benchmarks
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2611.25179v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Simulated manipulation benchmarks measure policy performance using hand-written success checkers that label each episode as a success or failure. Passing an expert demonstration shows that a checker accepts one way of completing the task. Learned policies, however, may stop after partial progress or complete the task in a different way. A checker may then accept an incomplete execution (phantom success) or reject an execution that satisfies the instruction (silent failure). In this paper, we introduce SimAudit, an LLM-based pipeline that audits success checkers against task instructions. SimAudit analyzes the instruction and checker code to identify scenarios where the two may disagree, recreates those scenarios in simulation, and runs the original checker. items.reason_zh: 系统审计仿真操作基准的成功判定器，揭示虚假成功与静默失败，对做具身评测的研究者极具警示价值。
items.summary_zh: 仿真操作基准通常用手写的成功判定器为每个回合打上成功或失败标签，但专家演示通过只说明判定器接受了一种完成任务的方式。学习到的策略可能在中途停下，或以不同方式完成任务，判定器却仍可能误判。论文系统审计了这类成功判定器，揭示出虚假成功与静默失败两类问题，说明基准分数可能高估策略能力。该工作对具身智能评测方法的可靠性提出了重要质疑。
items.title_zh: 虚假成功与静默失败：审计仿真操作基准的成功判定器

items.title: NVIDIA AI Releases Nemotron-Labs-Sigma, a Continuous Diffusion Language Model with 14 checkpoints at 3B/8B
items.raw_text:
NVIDIA released Nemotron-Labs-Sigma, 14 open 3B and 8B continuous diffusion language model checkpoints. Sigma denoises text in a learned 16-D embedding space, distills to few-step samplers, and decodes up to 4.20x faster than autoregressive decoding.

The post NVIDIA AI Releases Nemotron-Labs-Sigma, a Continuous Diffusion Language Model with 14 checkpoints at 3B/8B appeared first on MarkTechPost.
items.reason_zh: NVIDIA发布连续扩散语言模型Sigma，开源14个检查点，解码速度提升显著，技术新颖。
items.summary_zh: NVIDIA发布了Nemotron-Labs-Sigma，这是一个连续扩散语言模型系列，包含14个开源检查点，参数规模为3B和8B。Sigma在学习到的16维嵌入空间中对文本进行去噪，并蒸馏为少步采样器，解码速度最高可达自回归解码的4.20倍。该模型采用扩散方法生成文本，与主流自回归模型不同，可能在生成效率和多模态扩展方面具有潜力。开源检查点将促进相关研究和应用开发。
items.title_zh: NVIDIA AI发布Nemotron-Labs-Sigma：连续扩散语言模型，含3B/8B共14个检查点

items.reason_zh: METR 时间跨度图更新，揭示能力指数增长但判断类任务落后，值得关注 AI 能力评估的边界。
items.summary_zh: AI 评估非营利机构 METR 发布报告，更新其广受关注的“时间跨度”图表。报告显示，部分 AI 能力仍沿指数轨迹持续提升，模型可自主完成的任务时长不断延长；但同时指出，模型在需要判断力的任务上表现明显弱于编程类任务。这一差异说明能力增长并非全面均衡，评估基准的选择会显著影响对进展的判断。报告为理解 AI 能力演进的真实速度与短板提供了量化视角。
items.title_zh: AI 领域最被误解的图表迎来重大更新
